scope: All submitted source bodies and metadata, copied historical evidence and reachable Git history. Final execution evidence is regenerated against the privacy-revised frozen corpus. Exact unredacted originals remain privately archived outside Git.
categories_removed: personal names in examples and participant attribution
participant biographies and personal follow-up actions
meeting dates and venue identifying the note owner
source_policy: Public raw files are redacted copies, frozen before ingestion; no claim of byte identity to private originals.
public_git_history_policy: Fresh sanitized history replaces the prior reachable history for private delivery. Prior Git metadata remains only in a local archive.
